scientific_integrity: The new comparison is confined to the discriminant of rational elliptic fibrations with exactly six I_2 fibers; the Hermite invariant, bielliptic genus-two locus, and Humbert surface are classical. Exact finite tests do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers; six distinct branch/fiber points; reduced closure of hypersurface; birational only on generic coarse moduli; no full boundary or automorphism classification; no claim of priority for the classical Hermite invariant.
title: The six-nodal rational elliptic discriminant is the Hermite bielliptic divisor
